name: agent
description: The agent's mods: what used to be a rule in CLAUDE.md or a script on a timer now runs inside Claude Code

plugins.name: agent
plugins.description: The bundle with all of the agent's mods. Installing this plugin installs each mod as a dependency

plugins.name: usage-limit
plugins.description: Guards the account usage limit: one subagent at a time above 90%, a pause with a reserve at 98%, and an automatic resume when the window resets

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright below the memory high mark: runs them with a single process, waits or refuses, and retries a command that died with exit 137

plugins.name: skill-loader
plugins.description: Loads the right skill at the right time: typescript-best-practices when reading .ts, writing-for-agents on SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, domain-modeling on CONTEXT.md and ADRs, technical-writing on README, commits and PRs

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Records every MCP call that writes in one file per day, without refusing anything. /audit shows the last ones
